title: Manipulation
description: One MoveIt MoveGroup goal's lifecycle: a Record when it is accepted, one when it reaches a terminal state

event.description: Whether this Record is the start or the end of one manipulation goal

goal_id.description: The MoveGroup goal's own UUID, as a canonical hex string, correlating a start Record with its end

group_name.description: The planning group this Measurement instance watches, as configured -- not read off the goal, which is never broadcast

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing across every Record from this Measurement instance, so a dropped Record shows up as a gap

outcome.description: Derived from MoveIt's own error_code: SUCCESS succeeds, PREEMPTED is the closest thing MoveIt has to cancelled, everything else fails

error_code.description: MoveIt's own numeric MoveItErrorCodes, carried through verbatim

planning_time.description: Seconds MoveGroup spent planning, from MoveGroup::Result

duration_sec.description: How long the goal took from accepted to terminal
